subject: SRT production-path review: validated wrapper is active; no shared JM change required for this path
body:

SRT count issue is resolved at current source/transport-test level: real dispatch_v2 calls nord2_gpu_jm_build_compute with alignedbase at349, then n2mb_compute_srt_pointer validates base/count/table-span and writes encodedbase|4 at job+96 at350..351. Real selector9 path Nord2GPU.cpp592..596 -> n2c_submit(core.c654) validates handles/writeflags/jobheads, does not rerun the builder or require resourcepointerlowbits0. Existing JM src and shim hashes both8035a438...; no sharedchange necessary merely to make this active path accept count4. The isolated wrapper may still be consolidated by root, but earlier raw-SRT finding must not be reported as still unfixed.

Independently executed existing release n2mb_v2_job_test (fbc2e24d...) without rebuilding:111checks, exactly3required failures identical to report (sampler_index99, span1023 vs layout1024, swizzle0x210 replaced0x688). Rust binary4bad3821... matches report; worker air-work/src/lib.rs exactlymatches currentproductionf83ed62f....
